toxicity.Notes: Dose-finding experiment that precedes the xenograft study: male NMRI:nu/nu mice, two per group, single daily i.p. injections of 20, 40 or 80 mg/kg/day over five days. Body weight loss was 11 % at 20 and 40 mg/kg and 16 % at 80 mg/kg, the highest dose caused one toxic death on day 14 and the weight loss of the surviving mice was reversible. The abstract calls 30 mg/kg/day the maximum tolerable dose and that number is recorded here, although the Results only say that 30 mg/kg/day was chosen for the following experiment after these three doses; 30 mg/kg is not itself one of the doses tested. Survival per dose is not given as a percentage, only the single death at 80 mg/kg, so survival_pct is left empty. These animals were healthy, without tumours. Treatment arm (column removed 2026-11-09): Oxali-Titanocene Y, daily i.p. for five days, healthy male mice. Cohort (column removed 2026-11-09): ldd2008-mtd.
